description: Distribuidores Mayoristas:Despacho de combustibles líquidos a nivel nacional (AUTOMATIZADO) is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Ministerio de Minas y Energía - MinEnergía, Bogotá D.C.. Este conjunto de datos presenta los volúmenes despachados por los Distribuidores mayoristas para Colombia. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Minas y Energía - MinEnergía, Bogotá D.C.. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Minas y Energía. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
